The '''Pit Screamers''', also known as '''Screamers''', was a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] that participated in the [[All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally]] around [[3626 BBY]].

==Overview==
[[File:ThePitScreamers.png|thumb|right|250px|The Screamers]]
The Pit Screamers were known for inventing new [[Death/Legends|death-defying]] stunts and [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] biking tricks for many years, and their [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] skills were unmatched in [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]]. The Pit Screamers were loved by fans across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Codex" />

==History==
The Pit Screamers' leader during the [[All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally]] was [[Raossk]], who drove the gang to greater and more dangerous tricks and his single-minded focus was seen by some as an asset to the gang.<ref name="Codex" />
